customManagers.description: The Angular CLI installed globally in the debug image
The dotnet-ef tool the backend image uses to build the migrations bundle. semver versioning, because NuGet versioning reads a bare 10.0.0 as the range >= 10.0.0 and never offers an update

packageRules.description: Everything goes into one PR, majors included
Packages tied to the Angular or .NET version: keep minors in the big PR but split majors out

Angular majors get their own PR; they need ng update migrations and careful testing. @angular/material and @angular/cdk are covered by @angular/**; the @ng-matero libraries and ngx-drag-drop release one major per Angular major, so they ride along
zone.js is 0.x and each minor pairs with an Angular major; the slug makes its minor land in the same renovate/major-angular branch as the Angular majors
Node (the client build images and the CI setup-node versions, which Renovate looks up as actions/node-versions) must be a version the Angular CLI supports
Angular only supports one TypeScript minor at a time and ng update bumps it during Angular majors, so Renovate only does TypeScript patches

.NET majors get their own PR: the projects' TargetFramework (net10.0) has to move with them, which Renovate can't do. AspNet.Security.OAuth.* and the Serilog hosting/configuration bridges are versioned with .NET; dotnet-ef must match EF Core; dotnet-sdk is the CI setup-dotnet version
